name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: U.S. soldier killed in Iraq, Trump orders more strikes against Iran
changes.summary: A U.S. service member was killed in Iraq on Saturday, CENTCOM announced. Separately, unidentified remains were found in Jordan at the location where a U.S. service member went missing and two others were killed following an Iranian strike. Taurean Small reports.

changes.title: Oil Prices Cross $90 a Barrel as U.S.-Iran Conflict Widens
changes.summary: Brent crude, the global benchmark for oil, rose more than 3 percent as trading resumed on Sunday, while S&P 500 futures remained essentially unchanged.

changes.title: Rubio Says That U.S. Is Still Open to Diplomacy With Iran
changes.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio also said that Iran has signaled it wants to negotiate with the United States, even as the two sides escalated their attacks.

changes.title: Sen. Mark Warner says Middle East bases are "on and off under attack" since Iran war began
changes.summary: In the wake of the deaths of two U.S. service members over the weekend at a Jordanian military base, Democratic Sen. Mark Warner of Virginia told "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" that "these bases have been on and off under attack" since the beginning of the war of Iran, which he described as a "war of choice.".

changes.title: Increased Cooperation With U.S. Has Put Jordan in Iran’s Cross Hairs
changes.summary: Jordan’s role in U.S. operations against Iran has grown as other allies in the region have restricted Washington’s ability to use their bases and airspace.

changes.title: Nigerian children pay the price for the Iran war as malnutrition and poverty surge
changes.summary: Children relapsing into malnutrition has become an increasingly common occurrence in the state and across northern Nigeria, according to local health and aid workers, who cite knock-on effects from the Iran war.

changes.title: Oil Prices Cross $90 a Barrel as U.S.-Iran Conflict Widens
changes.summary: Brent crude, the global benchmark for oil, rose more than 3 percent as trading resumed on Sunday, while S&P 500 futures remained essentially unchanged.

changes.title: U.S. strikes Iran over troop deaths as Israel warns Tehran's attacks are coming close
changes.summary: Step by step, the U.S, and Iran have returned closer to all-out war as last month's interim deal meant to permanently end the fighting has crumbled and shipping traffic in the Strait of Hormuz has largely stalled.

changes.title: Why Jordan Is Becoming a New Focus in the U.S.-Iran War
changes.summary: Four Iranian attacks in five days have targeted U.S. troops in Jordan, U.S. officials said, including one on Friday that killed two soldiers and left another service member missing.

changes.title: Iran says it is suspending commitments to interim deal with U.S. as they exchange attacks
changes.summary: The widening strikes threatened civilians and services to them, including desalination plants for drinking water, while the global economy again was on alert.
